FN-FHHBDCD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 15
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Craig Lipscomb
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/13/2024
House Bill 15 as introduced provides for the Commissioner of the Department of Conservation
and Natural Resources (DCNR) to issue bass stocking permits to certain entities under certain
conditions. According to DCNR, these permits will be issued at no-cost to such entity.
